title.narrative: Capacity building to upgrade the livestock value chain in Ethiopia

description.narrative: With an estimated cattle population of 56.7 million in 2014, Ethiopia is home to the fifth largest cattle population in the world. The development of the livestock sector has the potential to play an important role in the socio-economic development of Ethiopia. The sector is one of the key priorities of the Programme for Country Partnership for Ethiopia (PCP-ETH) and the Growth and Transformation Plan (GTP I <(>&<)>GTP II). Nonetheless, the key value chains based on red meat continues to face constraints that are hindering their growth and export potential. In response, UNIDO in close collaboration with the Government of Ethiopia (GoE) is developing a large-scale livestock development pr ogramme (Upgrading the Livestock Value Chain Program of Ethiopia/ULVCP-ETH) that will be implemented in phases. Low capacity in terms of infrastructure and human resource development are main constraints hindering the development of export-oriented meat industry. There is also a lack of robust legislation to monitor the usage of various inputs like veterinary chemicals, water and stock feed. The objective of this phase of the project is to improve the competitiveness of the Ethiopian meat value chain in the global market.
